new_errors.location: Results, Subscale/Syndrome Comparisons, p. 52 (PDF p. 53); Table 5, p. 57 (PDF p. 58)
new_errors.reason: For the target comparison between the BASC-3 TRS-C Attention Problems scale and the ASCA Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity syndrome, the correlation is r = .66 (Table 5 and printed p. 52). The shipped value of 0.79 mistakenly came from the global composite correlation between BASC-3 Externalizing Problems and ASCA Overactivity on the same page.

new_errors.reason: For the target convergent-validity comparison between the BASC-3 TRS-C Attention Problems scale and the ASCA Attention Deficit Hyperactive syndrome, Katla (2024) reports r = .62 (p < .001).
